title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering during regional failover
author: Asha Patel
body: Context: During a regional outage last week we observed SLO enforcer backoff ordering races that caused cascading regional failovers and excessive load shedding. This PR stabilizes ordering in the SLO enforcer backoff path, adds guards to prevent duplicate backoff triggers, and improves metrics to make root-cause analysis easier. Motivation: customers experienced degraded throughput and higher 5xx rates during failover windows; mitigation must land as a hotfix. Changes: - Make backoff queue processing single-threaded per-enforcer and apply deterministic ordering by (enqueue_time, request_id) - Add an idempotency check to early-exit if an enforcer entry is already in backoff - Ensure regional-failover initiations set a short suppression window to avoid thrashing when regions flapping - Add metrics: slo_enforcer.backoff_triggered_total{reason}, slo_enforcer.backoff_suppressed_total - Add unit + integration tests simulating simultaneous region-failover and high QPS load - Documented configuration knobs and default values in docs/observability/slo-enforcer.md Rollout plan: 1) Deploy to canary region for 30 minutes under synthetic load 2) Monitor slo_enforcer.backoff_suppressed_total and 5xx rates 3) Gradual rollout to remaining regions if stable Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests with local canary harness - [x] Added metrics and dashboards - [x] Sanity validated in staging - [x] Included rollback steps Links: Linear ENG-2768, postmortem: internal/pm/regional-failover-2026-02 (internal link).
commits: a1b4d3c: stabilize enforcer queue ordering and add suppression window
b2c5f6e: add idempotency guard to backoff path
c3d6e7f: add metrics and dashboards for backoff/suppression
d4e7f8a: add integration tests for regional failover + load
changed_files: enforcer/slo_enforcer.go - centralize backoff queue processing and ordering logic
enforcer/queue.go - add deterministic comparator and locking
enforcer/metrics.go - add backoff metrics and tagging
docs/observability/slo-enforcer.md - document suppression window and knobs
review_comments: Marcus Nguyen: Can you explain why single-threaded processing is safe at our expected qps? Author reply: We keep a local fast-path for high QPS that bypasses the enforcer for confirmed cache hits; enforcer only evaluates mislabeled requests so throughput impact is negligible.
Priya Rao: Add a regression test that reproduces the ordering race. Author reply: added integration test regional_failover_test.go that drives concurrent failover and high load (see test scenario 3).
Diego Martinez (approved): Verified metrics and canary results; left minor nits around logging levels (fixed).
SRE rotation note: monitored canary for 45min, no observed thrash and 5xx decreased by 0.9%.
release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering to prevent regional failover thrashing. Fixes a race that could cause excessive load shedding during region flaps. Includes metrics and a suppression window to reduce thrash. No API changes.
notes: Backported to release/2026-02 (branch release/2026-02-hotfix-141999). Monitor slo_enforcer.backoff_triggered_total and slo_enforcer.backoff_suppressed_total during rollout.
